timestamp_semantics.event_at_source: Binance event/trade time when present; REST depth snapshot has no exchange event time and must be flagged
timestamp_semantics.published_at_source: Binance WebSocket event time or local received_at for REST snapshots with an explicit quality flag
timestamp_semantics.ingested_at_source: UTC collector clock after validation and before durable commit

revision_policy: Append-only by venue sequence/update id and content hash; never rewrite observed books or trades.
rationale: Prospective public market-data collection for BTC/ETH Binance Spot 4h research. No trading credentials, leverage, shadow or capital authorization.
